name: zanker-visualspec-documentation
description: Document already-created or conceptual visuals using Visual Spec as a reference only, never code generation.

workflow.instruction: Inspect real code/screenshot as the implementation source of truth.
Use https://visualspec.dev/specification/1.0 as documentation guidance; only author a spec document if schema is verified separately.

Run `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/document.sh --project . --title "Page" --source src/page.tsx --screenshots .zanker/reports/X/1440x900.png --visualspec docs/page.visualspec.json` to register reference.
Mark conceptual vs implemented and link source files and evidence.
Never take the Visual Spec JSON and generate, modify or reconstruct executable UI from it.

acceptance: Mark unverified schema rather than claiming conformance
fallback: Document screenshots and source links; omit unverified Visual Spec attachment.
